title: Psalm emits this issue when a method parameter differs from a parent method parameter, or if there are fewer parameters than the parent method.

title: Psalm emits this issue when a __clone, __construct, or __destruct method is defined with a return type.

title: In PHP 8.1+, most non-final internal methods now require overriding methods to declare a compatible return type, otherwise a deprecated notice is emitted during inheritance validation.
summary: Psalm reports it at each error level.
